target: Product-facing AI roles at startups shipping user-visible LLM features.

content.summary: Applied AI engineer who owns retrieval systems end to end — architecture, eval harness, LLM serving and cloud deployment. Shipped a multilingual RAG assistant now live in production on kheloindia.gov.in answering citizens in 12 languages, and sole-engineered a 60,000-LOC Parliamentary Question drafting platform piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Ships against measurement, not intuition: 213-case eval banks, judge-scored regression runs and latency budgets gate every release.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected and shipped a citizen-facing multilingual RAG assistant on Azure, 12 languages (9 voice-enabled) via Bhashini with Sarvam fallback, streaming SSE answers off a Service Bus queue and Redis pub/sub worker.

Designed hybrid retrieval that measurably beat naive cosine search: pgvector ANN over content chunks and 86,000 generated hypothetical questions, fused with pg_trgm lexical search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, plus an optional Cohere cross-encoder — lifting judged correctness to 3.9 / 4 across a 213-case eval bank.

Added a Hindi/English voice channel over the same assistant (built, in UAT) — Pipecat (Silero VAD → Sarvam STT → brain → Sarvam TTS), turn gate and echo guard, whole-buffer streaming redaction; architected so the gateway owns audio and the bot owns answers, rejecting two designs that added a second LLM hop and +1–2s. Time-to-first-token 12.6s → 9.1s; 40 gateway tests.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AI drafting platform (95 API endpoints, 34 tables, 33 migrations) piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session, grounding official replies in a 702-document corpus of prior tabled Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers.

Built a 10-stage retrieval pipeline on AWS Bedrock — semantic cache, LLM query planner, verbatim answer-of-record reuse, pgvector search, LLM reranking and recency blending with per-claim volatility half-lives — emitting per-sentence citations behind validation gates.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for both; re-platformed onto ECS Fargate (ARM64) + RDS Postgres 16 + ALB/WAF with a GitHub OIDC pipeline whose migrations run as an in-VPC one-off task and abort the deploy on failure. Expenditure platform tracks ₹924 Cr across 14 regional centres.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases, saving ~2 hrs of manual effort per cycle.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows, eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead, and consolidating 15+ scattered permission checks into one JWT RBAC middleware layer.

experience.context: Ed-tech platform delivering courses in web development, ML, and embedded systems to students across India.

bullets.text: Reduced frontend render latency by ~28% on a live multi-user ML platform (React DevTools Profiler) via React.memo and lazy loading — zero backend changes, zero regressions.
Built vendor-agnostic normalisation adapters over third-party ML APIs, fully decoupling business logic from vendor schemas and making future API swaps non-breaking.
